name: Chicago Tribune editorial board
lean_basis: AllSides rates the Chicago Tribune Center (online news; low or initial confidence, as of Oct. 2026). No separate editorial-board rating was found. Rating source: https://www.allsides.com/news-source/chicago-tribune-media-bias.

name: Chicago Sun-Times editorial board
lean_basis: Owned since 2022 by nonprofit Chicago Public Media (WBEZ's parent), a 501(c)(3), so it does not endorse candidates; it publishes voter guides and candidate questionnaires instead. AllSides rates its news Lean Left (medium confidence, Oct. 2026). Rating source: https://www.allsides.com/news-source/chicago-sun-times.

name: League of Women Voters of Chicago (VOTE411)
lean_basis: League of Women Voters chapter that describes itself as 'a nonpartisan, grassroots organization working to protect and expand voting rights' (https://www.lwvchicago.org/mission). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Injustice Watch: Check Your Judges
lean_basis: Not rated. The recorded description says: "the only newsroom in Cook County dedicated to reporting on the court system". This does not establish a position on the political scale. Source: https://www.injusticewatch.org/.

name: Illinois State Bar Association, Judicial Evaluation Committee
lean_basis: Statewide lawyers' association that rates judicial candidates only and takes no part in other races. Its site (https://www.isba.org/) returned errors on Oct. 17, 2026, so no mission statement could be quoted; shown as neutral, as a professional group.

name: Chicago Federation of Labor
lean_basis: Central labor council for Chicago and Cook County that says it 'fights to support workers in Chicago, Cook County, and beyond' (https://chicagolabor.org/about/). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Illinois Federation of Teachers (incl. Chicago Teachers Union, Local 1)
lean_basis: Statewide teachers' union (AFT affiliate, includes the Chicago Teachers Union) whose stated vision is 'Members fighting powerfully for a strong union and the future we all deserve' (https://www.ift-aft.org/about). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: SEIU Illinois State Council
lean_basis: Statewide council of SEIU locals. Its site (https://www.seiuillinois.org/) could not be read on Oct. 17, 2026. Not rated: with no stated mission and no outside rating available, no position on the political scale is shown.

name: Toni Preckwinkle, Cook County Board President
lean_basis: Democratic officeholder (Cook County Board President, on this ballot for re-election). Endorsement here is as reported by FOX 32.

name: Brandon Johnson, Mayor of Chicago
lean_basis: Mayor of Chicago (city offices are elected without party labels; he is a Democrat). FOX 32 reports he 'has voiced support' for Hilario Dominguez for school board president.

name: U.S. Rep. Danny Davis (IL-7, retiring)
lean_basis: Democratic congressman for the 7th District, not seeking re-election. Endorsements as reported by FOX 32 (school board) and Wikipedia (IL-7).

name: U.S. Rep. Raja Krishnamoorthi (IL-8, leaving the House)
lean_basis: Democratic congressman who ran for U.S. Senate in 2026. Endorsement as reported by FOX 32.

name: Illinois Policy Institute
lean_basis: Free-market research group that calls itself 'the strongest voice for taxpayers in the state' and 'a nonpartisan 501(c)(3) research organization' (https://www.illinoispolicy.org/about-us/). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.
